title: Concentric cylinders: convergence of D and of the profiles
status: final (rc2 runs) for g <= 200 dx; the rows at g = 400 dx are not reached
caption: Convergence between concentric cylinders, K = 3, w = 0 on both walls, in the micropolar length resolved (l / dx = 5, 10, 20; h = 5 dx; Ma = 0.02, Re = 10 on mu_inf, 25 on mu). (a) Deviation of the relative torque change D (velocity fit, against the run's Newtonian control) from the exact value; horizontal bars: the noise floor of D (spread of the control's beta over three lattices); dotted: power law through the points of m = 5 and m = 10 above their floor, order 2.2. (b), (c) Rms deviation of the bin means of v_theta and of w from the exact profiles, relative to the rms of the profile, further than h from both walls (circles) and within h of a wall (squares). Filled symbols, solid lines: m = 5 (runs `g050_k3_m5`, `g100_k3_m5`, `g200_k3_m5`); open symbols, dashed lines: m = 10 (`g100_k3_m10`, `g200_k3_m10`); open triangles, dash-dotted lines: m = 20 (`g200_k3_m20`, `g400_k3_m20`; l = 5 dx at g = 200 dx and l = 10 dx at g = 400 dx. The pair at g = 400 dx is the only one whose step is set by the viscous limit; it has one lattice and carries the floor of g = 200 dx; it is not in the fitted line). Order between successive resolutions: m = 5: 2.03, 2.30; m = 10: 2.06; m = 20: 1.09. Tag `thesis-ch5-rc2`, `thesis-ch5-rc2-1-gcb243fd`, `thesis-ch5-rc2-2-g7a21ef4`, `thesis-ch5-rc2-3-g656e652`, `thesis-ch5-rc2-36-g5b63f42`. Deviation of D: m = 5: +2.97 %, +0.73 %, +0.15 %; m = 10: +3.13 %, +0.75 %; m = 20: +3.22 %, +1.52 %. Not in the figure yet: `g400_k3_m10`.
